bundle.shortDescription: Build Steam / umu Proton launch commands
bundle.longDescription: A polished GUI for building Steam launch options and umu-launcher commands for Proton. Scans runtimes, games and shortcuts; toggles a searchable env-var catalog; previews and copies the command.
